g.text: Task exchange and geometric association on the reserved test
Fixed model weights · Held-out images and class combinations
Three paired seeds averaged before analysis; bars show image-bootstrap 95% confidence intervals.
Exchange effects compare task-specific selections on the same image. H2 slopes describe associations with task-direction angles.
